# A test that resolves a name reads the hosts file's answer for that name and
# the parts of resolv.conf the resolver used, not the files. Their other lines
# differ from host to host, so each file stands in the inputs as its lookups,
# not as a stat and an open.

env GOCACHE=$WORK/gocache
env GODEBUG=gocachetest=1
go test -run=TestResolvesLocalhost .
stdout '^ok\s+m\s+[0-9.]+s$'
stderr 'testcache: m: input lookup hostsname "localhost" \S+ [0-9a-f]+$'
stderr 'testcache: m: input lookup resolvorder "" \S+ [0-9a-f]+$'
! stderr 'testcache: m: input (stat|open) \S*(hosts|resolv\.conf) [0-9a-f]+$'

go test -run=TestResolvesLocalhost .
stdout '^ok\s+m\s+\(cached\)$'

-- go.mod --
module m

go 1.27
-- m_test.go --
package m

import (
	"context"
	"net"
	"testing"
)

func TestResolvesLocalhost(t *testing.T) {
	resolver := &net.Resolver{PreferGo: true}
	addrs, err := resolver.LookupHost(context.Background(), "localhost")
	t.Log(addrs, err)
}
